changes.title: Roster variety
items: A kind's island has more kinds of creature and fewer repeats: each other kind lives in one area while kinds from its own side of the compass last, and gets a second only after.

changes.title: Guest beach cache
items: Visiting a friend's island no longer rebuilds its beach for every game and music update.

changes.title: Challenge statues
items: The challenge circle's animals stand as grey stone statues by their columns until you step onto its stone floor
Step in and they glow red for four bars, then wake as a wild pack on the beat
Once awake they chase you anywhere; fly off over the treetops outside the challenge area, or get knocked down, and the ones you haven't won go back to their posts as stone, fully healed
The challenge circle's carved sigil follows the fight: faint moonlight while the statues sleep, red as they wake, cold blue in the fight, warm once they're all won
The challenge circle's stone floor catches a little more moonlight, so you can see it before you step in
Animals you've won over wander their area out of the way of your fights until the spell is cast
The music spell's analyser fills the whole challenge circle as you cast it

changes.title: Challenge edge
items: The challenge circle now sits out on the island's edge, in its far half from home, and the ley line goes round it instead of running over it
